Parent Embraer holds 162 granted patents incl. 15 eVTOL-categorized — substantial backstop IP. Eve's own corpus is small but the granted patents that exist are in the claimed domain (VTOL aircraft) — no Nikola-style mismatch.
scores.interpretation: Per heuristic note (Eve's IP may historically be filed under Embraer's name), the combined Eve+Embraer assignee portfolio (164 granted, 17 eVTOL/avionics-tagged) supports the 'technology and IP portfolio' claim. Direct Eve UAM patents that do exist are on-domain (VTOL). PASS.

calibration_notes: Foreign issuer (Embraer parent): EDGAR fulltext returned 0 for Embraer's own CIK on every term incl. 'Embraer' — clear tool indexing artifact, not absence of disclosure.
Parent corroboration via EPA FRS (13 Embraer FL facilities incl. Melbourne) substituted for the missing CIK-restricted disclosure check.
Eve's standalone IP portfolio is small (2 granted) but parent Embraer has 162 granted incl. 15 eVTOL-categorized — combined portfolio is on-domain.
UAL counterparty disclosure is unambiguous (7 'Eve Holding' hits in UAL's own filings).
